belief_statement: Preliminary evidence indicates that adult age group may influence community higher levels quality. The evidence base (3 findings, 1 studies) is growing but not yet conclusive.

mechanisms.pathway: adult age group → [unknown mechanism] → community higher levels quality

latent_variables.name: Dose and duration
latent_variables.rationale: Most studies measure presence/absence of adult age group, not dose-response curves. Duration and intensity likely matter.
latent_variables.suggested_measure: Parametric variation of intensity and exposure duration

research_needs.question: Does the effect of adult age group on community higher levels quality replicate in a pre-registered RCT?
research_needs.rationale: Current confidence is moderate. A well-powered pre-registered replication would most efficiently resolve the status of this belief.

research_needs.question: What is the dose-response curve for adult age group effects on community higher levels quality?
research_needs.rationale: Dose-response data enables design guidelines with specific thresholds.
